name: Delay
description: Delays the output state changes based on switch-on and switch-off delay durations

inputs.name: Trigger
inputs.description: Input signal that triggers the delayed output. When high, output will be delayed by 'don' duration. When low, output will be delayed by 'doff' duration.

outputs.name: Output
outputs.description: Delayed output signal. Switches ON after 'don' delay when trigger goes high, and switches OFF after 'doff' delay when trigger goes low.

config.name: Duration switch-on delay
config.description: Delay duration before the output is switched ON when input goes high

config.name: Duration switch-off delay
config.description: Delay duration before the output is switched OFF when input goes low

state.name: Last trigger state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the trigger input to detect edges
